Interface FlightPhaseController

All Superinterfaces:
GuiController
All Known Implementing Classes:
FlightPhaseControllerL1, FlightPhaseControllerL2
public interface FlightPhaseController extends GuiController
Interface for the Flight Phase Controller, which handles the interactions during the flight phase of the game. It extends GuiController to provide methods for updating the GUI based on game events.
